model_under_test: World Bank WDI benchmark formula family selected on training years only: y_t = y_t-1 + (y_t-1 - y_t-2)

comparator_baseline.name: WDI carry-forward baseline
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: predict heldout year as the immediately previous training year

negative_controls.description: carry-forward baseline must have larger absolute residual than the selected formula on this heldout row

falsifiers: support fails if carry-forward residual is not larger than model residual on any heldout WDI row
